description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'ImmutableEntityInterceptor' that extends Hibernate's EmptyInterceptor to enforce immutability rules on specific entity types in the OpenMRS system. It manages intercepting entity modifications to prevent changes to immutable entities or to certain properties, supports thread-local mutable property overrides, and handles entity-specific constraints related to voided or retired states.

classes.name: ImmutableEntityInterceptor
classes.description: Abstract Hibernate interceptor for enforcing immutability constraints on specific entity types, with support for configurable mutable properties and handling voided/retired states.

methods.name: getSupportedType
methods.description: Returns the entity class type supported by this interceptor. Must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getMutablePropertyNames
methods.description: Returns an array of property names that are allowed to be mutable; null or empty indicates the entity is fully immutable.

methods.name: ignoreVoidedOrRetiredObjects
methods.description: Indicates whether voided or retired entities are considered mutable.

methods.name: onFlushDirty
methods.description: Hibernate interceptor method that checks entity changes during flush; throws exception if forbidden modifications are detected.

methods.name: isMutableProperty
methods.description: Determines if a specific property is allowed to be mutable, considering configured properties and thread-local overrides.

methods.name: addMutablePropertiesForThread
methods.description: Allows setting additional mutable properties for the current thread to bypass default immutability restrictions.

methods.name: removeMutablePropertiesForThread
methods.description: Clears any thread-local mutable property overrides, should be called after the operation completes.
